claim: PAPER: symplectic leapfrog is T-symmetric to error 0.003; symplectic integrators are time-reversible with O(dt^q) reconstruction error
verdict: the coarsest dt escapes the bounded disk (boundary clipping dominates its error), but the three bounded dt levels show reversal error decaying ~O(dt^6.93) and reaching 5.89e-07 at dt=0.000125 -- an order of magnitude below the PAPER's 0.003.  The 0.003 figure is a dt-dependent integrator bound, not a broken-symmetry signal.
note: C0 = 24.4348 (V(0)); reverse window W=1000; bounded prefix only.
